Name: VO1KOV YT Music
Description: Like, dislike, add the current track to your playlists (with covers, browse with a knob), start track radio and My Supermix in YouTube Music for Chrome. Needs the free bridge extension for Chrome, included with the plugin. Unofficial, not affiliated with Google or YouTube.
